Fixture: OneTrust save that reloads and never satisfies the extension's verification

Reproduces the unbounded reload loop that auto-disabled www.cnbc.com and kpmg.com in real use (2026-09-06), which the earlier single-reload fixtures in this directory did NOT catch — they reloaded once and then settled, so they passed while production kept looping.

The pathological shape modelled here: the site's save control (a) writes a consent cookie, (b) reloads the page, and (c) leaves the extension's own post-reload verification unsatisfiable, so every fresh load looks like "not handled yet" and the whole flow runs again. Here that's done by omitting the CCPA "_BG" opt-out group from the cookie's groups= list entirely while still showing the banner — mirroring the real possibility that a _BG group the extension puts in expectedGroups simply never appears in OptanonConsent's groups field, making oneTrustConsentGroupsMatch() a permanent false. The write/reload race produces the same observable loop intermittently; this fixture makes it deterministic.
